Also his department - The Ministry of Agriculture, Fish and Food, which includes Belgravians Susan Kew, Sue Morrison, Derrick Williams, John Hall and John Llewellin took the Department Award.

The team race was another win for Belgrave, but only due to Stone not being entered in the Steyning team, John Llewellin replaced Eric Crutcher as 4th man and John Hall and Carl Lawton repeated their Enfield positions.
A welcome return to John Llewellin after injury and long lay off and hopefully Paul Warburton making some sort of comeback but regretably no younger faces to the side.
Carl Lawton (8th.53:51), John Hall (9th.54:19) John Llewellin (20th.56:55), John Dunsford (32th.60:53), Fotheringham (34th. 61:20), Sharpe (46th.65:34), George Beecham (54th.71:53)
In the Belgrave 3kms Championships held at Battersea Park on September 2nd in conjunction with the MAFF meeting, John Hall was the winner with John Llewellin and Carl Lawton backing up.

Back to Blackheath for another Bels. win; this time in the form of John Hall in his Min of Ag. colours, making light of the undulating course. He was followed by the rarely seen shape of John Llewellin, now working in deepest Kent. 1, J.Hall 54:08; ... 3, J.Llewellin 55:??.

John Llewellin, exiled to darkest Kent, is seen all too rarely in the claret-and-gold these days, but proved that if, and of course it's a big 'if', we had our strongest team available, Bels would be up there with the best far more often.
